chapter: Piron, Pichon and the boat bands
title: Mac Lacey the drummer and the Devoiney family
summary: They discuss drummer Mac Lacey, his brother Joe, and the musical Devoiney family.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: You ever seen Mac Lacey's brother, Joe?
I've seen him all the time. He drives a rocket. Get his address from him. Yeah, alright. I sure will.
Yeah, cause I like to find out who Mac played with. Yeah, alright.
Yeah, Mac, well that's who was to go with over them, you see. Yeah. But I went instead. I was sick then.
Did you see Mac much other than that?
Yeah, well I went to Fisk School right there, you know, and he stayed around the corner. I was just going to see him pretty regular.
Yeah. Who was he with? Do you remember that?
He was playing with some man around here. I believe he was playing at them Tunks too, I think. I forget what man Mac was playing. Yeah. Nice little drummer.

Oh, there was a woman who played piano for the rubber show, Ms. Margaret or something. Oh yeah, Margaret. Devoiney. Oh good, we got her name, you mentioned her before. Yeah, Devoiney. Couldn't think of her last name. Big family then, Devoiney's. Several of them played music, didn't they? Yeah, family then.
I believe Ernest Rappanian's wife was a Devoiney. Oh, really? Yeah. It was a Charles DeVerny or something, played trombone or something.
She's what? I think it was a Charles DeVerny played trombone or something. Yeah, it's a big family.
A lot of them living, yeah. We were around Tyler Downey living there. I mean Della Shays and them.
